title: The commit hook adds KB-Operator with the operator id to an agent session's commits, and check-trailers refuses an email there
goal: the commit-msg hook adds KB-Operator: <operator id of kbwho.operator()> to each commit made in an agent session (bl_authority.in_agent_session), beside KB-Teams and KB-Work, and none to a commit made outside one; kbgit.py check-trailers accepts an operator id in KB-Operator and refuses a KB-Operator value shaped like an email address, naming the commit

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, json, re
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
C = os.path.join(T, "clone")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copytree(".claude/hooks", os.path.join(C, ".claude", "hooks"))
for f in ("backlog.json", ".gitignore"):
    shutil.copy(f, C)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
shutil.copy("kb/_self/map.csv", os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "map.csv"))
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.makedirs(B)
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"  # built at run time: no address sits in the check's text
def stub(body):
    p = os.path.join(B, "claude"); open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\n" + body + "\n"); os.chmod(p, 0o755)
stub("echo '{\"loggedIn\": true, \"authMethod\": \"claude.ai\", \"email\": \"%s\"}'" % EM)
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(PATH=os.pathsep.join([B, os.path.dirname(shutil.which("git")), "/usr/bin", "/bin"]), HOME=T,
           GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def run(tool, *a, stdin=None, **kw):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, *tool.split("/")) if "/" in tool else os.path.join(C, "_tools", tool), *a],
                          cwd=C, env={**ENV, **kw}, input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
shutil.copytree(".githooks", os.path.join(C, ".githooks"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "notes"), exist_ok=True)
g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "hooks", "--no-verify")
r = run("kbgit.py", "install-hooks"); assert r.returncode == 0, ("install-hooks", r.stderr[-300:])
O = dict(ENV, KB_OPERATOR="op-test0001", KB_ROLE="orchestrator")
def commit(name, env):
    open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "notes", name), "w").write(name + "\n")
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=C, env=env, check=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-qm", "docs: " + name], cwd=C, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, ("commit fails", name, r.stderr[-300:])
    return g("log", "-1", "--format=%(trailers:key=KB-Operator,valueonly)").strip()
v = commit("agent.md", dict(O, CLAUDECODE="1"))
assert v == "op-test0001", ("an agent session's commit does not get KB-Operator: op-test0001", v, g("log", "-1", "--format=%B"))
v = commit("person.md", O)
assert v == "", ("a commit made outside an agent session gets KB-Operator", v)
r = run("kbgit.py", "check-trailers", "HEAD~2..HEAD")
assert r.returncode == 0, ("check-trailers refuses the KB-Operator trailer", r.returncode, r.stdout[-400:])
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "notes", "bad.md"), "w").write("bad\n"); g("add", "-A")
g("commit", "-qm", "docs: bad\n\nKB-Operator: " + EM, "--no-verify")
r = run("kbgit.py", "check-trailers", "HEAD~1..HEAD")
assert r.returncode != 0 and "KB-Operator" in r.stdout + r.stderr, ("check-trailers accepts an email address in KB-Operator", r.returncode, r.stdout[-300:])

notes: Premise (2026-10-19): in a planted clone with the hooks installed, a commit made with CLAUDECODE=1 and KB_OPERATOR set gets no KB-Operator trailer.
